controls.name: Price unknown warning
controls.label:
This spends OpenAI API credits. The Chat Place has no price for future-model, so it can't estimate the cost, and your dollar limits can't stop a message.

An allowance of up to $2.00 will be held for each message against your overall limit. This allowance limits later sends; it cannot limit what this message costs. Stop keeps the allowance when the cost is unknown.
